listing.name: Android9k's Python Script Emporium
listing.summary: A collection of python scripts to serve my miscellaneous needs.
listing.aiSummary: Provides Python scripts for modifying game files and collecting hull styles.

description: Offers a collection of Python scripts designed for miscellaneous modding tasks. Includes tools to modify ship sizes and faction doctrines by editing game files directly. Also features a script that recursively searches for hull style definitions to help configure hex shield overlays.
